description:
Events on sale on UPFRONT (games, concerts, shows, comedy), soonest
first. Matches requests like "Knicks games next week", "concerts in
Denver this weekend" or "something fun near Fenway under $100".

query: words matched against the event, venue or city ("Hamilton",
"Madison Square Garden"); "*" (the default) means no text filter.
near: a place name ("Denver", "Fenway Park", "Austin, TX"): only
events within radius km (default 100) of it.
lat/lng: coordinates of a location the user has shared.
performer: a team or artist ("Knicks", "Olivia Rodrigo"): only
events they play. More exact than query for a team or artist.
categories: zero or more of exactly these values: mlb, nba, nfl,
nhl, mma, ncaaFootball, ncaaBasketball, wwe, soccer, boxing,
tennis, popRock, rapHipHop, country, latin, alternative, hardRock,
reggae, world, classical, religious, musicFestivals, broadway,
musical, dance, opera, comedy. There is no generic "concerts"
value; music is split into the genres listed.
start_datetime/end_datetime: absolute local ISO datetimes. "This
weekend" is the coming Saturday 00:00 to Sunday 23:59:59; "tonight"
is today 00:00 to 23:59:59. Without them, every upcoming date counts.
max_price: the most per ticket, fees included, in dollars.
page/per_page: further pages of results.

The catalog records no audience, vibe or popularity; categories and
words in event names ("Family", "18+") are the closest signals.

Returns events: eventId, name, venue, city, state, startsAt (local),
fromAllInPrice, url. fromAllInPrice is the lowest per-ticket price
on UPFRONT with every fee in, as the event page showed it at
UPFRONT's last check; it is not a quote for a number of tickets,
and null means none listed right now. url is the event's page on
UPFRONT. Parking and tailgate events (isParkingEvent) come after the
games. place says where `near` was read as; performer says which
team or artist was used, with otherMatches when the name could mean
others. An empty list can also mean the search failed.
name: find_events
